item.text:
Continued. I checked the `dlog` nil-logger path and found a concrete, low-severity API defect.

F22: `dlog.Logger`’s explicit nil-receiver fallback logs, then continues into `l.verbose` and panics.

`TestAuditNilLoggerDoesNotPanic`:

```
2026/10/18 01:10:40 audit nil logger
nil *Logger panicked instead of using the fallback logger: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
```

The code appears to intend a fallback to the standard logger, but does not return after the nil branch. The shipped `runReplica`/`runMaster` callers pass a non-nil logger, so this is a library/API robustness defect rather than a default-deployment failure.

Current status: 22 findings documented; four cluster controls pass; 34 epaxos finding tests fail as intended; both client failover tests and the dlog nil-logger test fail; `go build ./...` passes; captured implementation files remain byte-identical to `../source`.
